storefronts.title: Storefronts
storefronts.subtitle: Each storefront is its own grid and theme. Create as many as you need, then open one to edit it.

looks.title: Looks
looks.infoBody: A look sets the whole storefront's colours, font, corners, spacing and what a product tile shows in one go. Your layout, your products and any tile you styled by hand are left exactly as they are.
looks.hintMinimal: Pictures only. Name and price on hover.
looks.hintClassic: Name and price under every picture.
looks.hintBold: Price always on the picture, name on hover.

background.label: Background
background.dragAriaLabel: Drag to position the background image
background.dragHint: Drag the preview to reposition. Zoom to resize.
background.uploadHint: Up to 10 MB. JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or AVIF.

cardStyle.roundedHint: Rounded cards keep both labels on the center axis.
cardStyle.spotHint: Click a spot to place the label, or drag it here or on the tile.
cardStyle.hoverHint: The title stays hidden until a buyer hovers over the product.
cardStyle.revealTop: The bar slides down from the top when a buyer hovers.
cardStyle.revealMiddle: The bar fades in when a buyer hovers.
cardStyle.revealBottom: The bar slides up from the bottom when a buyer hovers.

priceTag.roundedHint: Rounded cards keep the tag on the center axis.
priceTag.dragHint: Drag it on the tile, or use the layout board, to choose a spot.
priceTag.sizeTip: The size on a single tile. The tag scales with the tile it sits on, so a bigger block wears a bigger price without you setting one.

layout.blocksWide: {n, plural, one {# blocks wide} other {# blocks wide}}
layout.heightTip: The board can't shrink below the blocks already on it: drag a block up first, then shorten the canvas.
layout.blocksTall: {n, plural, one {# blocks tall} other {# blocks tall}}
layout.gridGapValue: {n, plural, one {# pixel gap} other {# pixel gap}}
layout.gridInfoBody: A guide for you while you design: it draws the empty slots so you can see where a block will land. Buyers never see it.

placement.rotationTipSingle: Whole degrees, either way from level. The block turns about its own centre and keeps the cells it occupies.
placement.rotationTipMultiple: Whole degrees, either way from level. Each block turns about its own centre, so a row of blocks stays a row.
placement.rotateTo: Rotate to {n, plural, one {# degrees} other {# degrees}}

header.infoLabel: Other ways to edit the header
header.infoBody: Click the name or bio on the canvas to type it there. This panel opens on that line at the same time, where its font, size, colour, formatting and alignment are set.
header.bioPlaceholder: A short line about your shop
header.charsLeft: {n, plural, one {# characters left} other {# characters left}}

soldOut.hideInfoBody: Products you marked sold out disappear from the storefront entirely. They stay on the canvas here, dimmed, so you can still move them and put them back on sale.
soldOut.badgeInfoBodyHidden: Nothing to mark while sold-out products are hidden. Turn Hide from buyers off and this badge labels them instead.
soldOut.badgeInfoBodyVisible: Marks a sold-out product on the storefront, so a buyer learns it exists and is gone rather than wondering.

typography.fontInfoBody: WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF, up to 2 MB. WOFF2 is the one to use: it is the smallest, so it is the fastest for a buyer to load, and every browser reads it.

showPage.label: Show a product page
showPage.infoOn: Tapping a product tile opens its page.
showPage.infoOff: Product tiles have no page to open.

font.label: Font
font.infoLabel: How this page's font relates to the storefront's
font.infoOwn: This page reads in its own face, whatever the storefront uses.
font.infoFollows: Follows your storefront's font. Change it under Typography.

indexing.label: Allow search engines
indexing.infoContent: Off keeps your product pages out of search results. Anyone with a link can still open them.

cta.title: Buy button
cta.infoLabel: What decides whether a button shows
cta.infoContent: The button follows each product’s purchase link (set on the product). Without one it emails your contact address below; with neither, no button is shown.

buttonText.label: Button text
buttonText.charsLeft: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}

sections.title: Sections
sections.infoContent: A section with nothing to show stays hidden even when it is on. Shipping and safety never show for downloads. Safety and compliance and Seller are legal disclosures and cannot be turned off.

shippingReturns.title: Shipping and returns
shippingReturns.infoLabel: Why this lives in Settings, not here
shippingReturns.infoContent: Set once for your whole account, so every storefront and every product sells under the same terms. For EU sellers the page also states the 14-day cancellation right and the 2-year guarantee, whatever you write.
shippingReturns.profileCount: {count, plural, one {# shipping profile for products that ship differently.} other {# shipping profiles for products that ship differently.}}
shippingReturns.nothingSet: Nothing set yet. Until you add your terms, product pages say the seller has not added shipping details.

sellerDetails.title: Seller details
sellerDetails.infoLabel: Why this lives in Settings, not here
sellerDetails.infoContent: Distance-selling law asks for the seller’s name, address and a way to get in touch next to every offer. Set once for your whole account — every storefront and every product shows the same details, so there is nothing to repeat per store.
sellerDetails.nothingSet: Nothing set yet. Until you add your business details, buyers only see the “Sold by” line under the title.

productBlock.deleted: This product was removed from your catalog.

whereChangeLands.label: Where a name or price change lands
whereChangeLands.content: Name and price belong to the product, so saving updates them everywhere it appears, not just this storefront.

stock.outOfStock: Out of stock in inventory (0 on hand).

tileStyle.title: Tile style
tileStyle.infoLabel: How this tile's style relates to the theme
tileStyle.infoWithOverrides: This tile has its own style. Settings you have not changed here keep following the theme.
tileStyle.infoNoOverrides: Style this tile on its own. Anything you do not change keeps following the theme.

modal.title: Update product everywhere?
modal.description: This edits the product itself. Every storefront, checkout link, and your product catalog will show the new details, not just this grid.

validation.badPrice: Price must be a number greater than zero.

text.label: Text
text.infoLabel: Other ways to edit this text
text.infoContent: You can also click the block again on the canvas and type straight onto it, which is quicker for a small change.

textBlock.colouringSelected: Colouring the {count, plural, one {# selected character} other {# selected characters}}. Click away from the words to colour the whole block instead.

size.label: Size
size.fillHint: Fills the block, cropping the overflow.
size.fitHint: Shows the whole image inside the block.

description.label: Description
description.hint: Read aloud by screen readers. Leave it empty if the image is purely decorative.
